ex: Webcasting lets people watch the meeting online from home.
The school uses webcasting for its graduation ceremony.
Can we use webcasting for the training next week?
Webcasting needs a good camera and fast internet.
Divers breathe nitrox to stay underwater longer.
Nitrox is air with extra oxygen in it.
Do I need a special course to dive with nitrox?
Fill this tank with nitrox, not normal air.
Tathagata is a name the Buddha used for himself.
In Buddhist texts, the Tathagata teaches the path to peace.
The monk read a story about the Tathagata.
What does the word tathagata mean in Buddhism?
A flavivirus can cause dengue or yellow fever.
Mosquitoes carry many types of flavivirus.
Is there a vaccine against this flavivirus?
Doctors tested her blood for a flavivirus after the trip.
A hypergraph is a graph where one edge can join many points.
Our math course has a chapter on hypergraphs.
The program uses a hypergraph to show group connections.
Can you draw this hypergraph on the board?
Syenite is a hard rock similar to granite.
The kitchen counter is made of gray syenite.
Syenite has very little quartz in it.
The geologist found syenite near the old quarry.
A carbapenem is a strong antibiotic for serious infections.
Doctors keep carbapenems for bacteria that resist other drugs.
The patient got a carbapenem through a drip in the hospital.
Some dangerous bacteria now resist carbapenems too.
Palmitate is a common form of fat in food and creams.
Vitamin A palmitate is often added to milk.
Check the label for palmitate in this face cream.
Palm oil is a common source of palmitate.
A doppio is a double shot of espresso.
Can I have a doppio with a glass of water?
I drink a doppio every morning before work.
This café sells a doppio for three dollars.
The Tetragrammaton is the four Hebrew letters for God's name.
Many Jews do not say the Tetragrammaton aloud.
The guide showed us the Tetragrammaton carved above the door.
Old Bibles sometimes print the Tetragrammaton in Hebrew letters.
In Islam, kufr means not believing in God.
The imam explained the meaning of kufr to the students.
Some groups accuse their opponents of kufr.
The book explains the difference between faith and kufr.
A humectant pulls water into your skin.
Glycerin is a common humectant in face creams.
Does this lotion contain a humectant for dry skin?
Honey works as a natural humectant in hair masks.
Supermoto is motorcycle racing on both road and dirt.
He rides a supermoto bike to work every day.
The supermoto race has jumps and sharp turns.
Is a supermoto good for city riding?
Your body makes hydroxybutyrate when you eat very few carbs.
The blood test measures hydroxybutyrate levels in diabetes.
High hydroxybutyrate can be a sign of a serious problem.
Some sports drinks contain hydroxybutyrate for extra energy.
A cognomen was the family nickname in a Roman name.
Many Roman men had a first name, a clan name, and a cognomen.
Our teacher asked us to find the cognomen in each name.
A cognomen often described how a person looked.
A rotoscope lets artists draw over real film frames.
The studio used a rotoscope for the dancing scenes.
Artists traced each frame of the video with a rotoscope.
Old cartoons often used a rotoscope to show real movement.
A penni was a small coin in old Finnish money.
One hundred penni made one Finnish markka.
My grandmother kept a ten penni coin from Finland.
Finland stopped using the penni when the euro came.

despawn.note: Gaming slang; more often a verb.

ex: Our partners can see the orders on the company extranet.
Log in to the extranet to download the price list.
Can you give the new supplier access to our extranet?
The hotel updates its rooms through the booking extranet.
Laghman is a soup with long noodles, meat, and vegetables.
Can we order two bowls of laghman, please?
This Uzbek café makes laghman with fresh noodles.
My mother cooks spicy laghman on cold days.
The patcher downloads small fixes for the game.
Run the patcher before you start the program.
The patcher stopped at fifty percent, so I restarted it.
Does this patcher work on older versions of the game?
In philosophy, a noema is a thing as we experience it.
The lecture explained what a noema is with simple examples.
For you, the noema of a tree is the tree you see.
She wrote her thesis on the noema in perception.

petaflops.note: Petaflops is both singular and plural: "one petaflops."

ex: A rickroll is a joke link that opens an old music video.
I clicked the link, and it was a rickroll.
His birthday invitation was a rickroll, and everyone laughed.
Is this link real or just another rickroll?
A tabulator is a machine that counts and sorts data.
The election office uses a tabulator to count paper ballots.
Old punched-card tabulators helped count the national census.
The museum shows an early electric tabulator from the 1890s.
A samhita is a collection of old Hindu hymns.
The Rigveda Samhita is the oldest text of the Vedas.
Our teacher read a short hymn from the samhita.
Priests learn the samhita by heart.
A temari is a Japanese ball covered with colorful thread.
My aunt makes temari as gifts for children.
We learned to wrap a temari in our craft class.
Can you show me how to stitch a temari pattern?

mucin.note: Usually uncountable when it means the substance.

ex: A chelator binds metals so the body can remove them.
Doctors use a chelator to treat lead poisoning.
The patient got a chelator through a drip every week.
Some soaps contain a chelator to work better in hard water.
A sarcomere is the smallest working part of a muscle fiber.
The sarcomere gets shorter when a muscle contracts.
Under the microscope, each sarcomere looks like a small band.
Our biology test had a drawing of a sarcomere.
A siderophore helps bacteria take iron from their surroundings.
Many soil bacteria produce siderophores to get iron.
The scientists measured siderophores in the water samples.
Without siderophores, these germs cannot grow well in the body.
A pastorale is a calm piece of music about country life.
The orchestra played a gentle pastorale for flute and strings.
The opera opens with a short pastorale.
She practiced a Christmas pastorale on the piano.
Donepezil is a medicine for memory loss in Alzheimer's disease.
My grandmother takes donepezil every evening.
Donepezil can cause bad dreams in some people.
Ask the doctor before you stop taking donepezil.
A solera is a system of barrels for aging wine.
This sherry is aged in a solera for many years.
In a solera, new wine is mixed with older wine.
The winery tour showed us the old solera barrels.

pro-choicer.note: Informal; "pro-choice supporter" or "abortion-rights supporter" is more neutral.

ex: A cinemagraph is a photo where one small part moves.
The website uses a cinemagraph of steam rising from coffee.
Can you make a cinemagraph from this short video?
In the cinemagraph, only her hair moves in the wind.
A monoterpene gives many plants their strong smell.
Lemon peel contains a monoterpene called limonene.
Pine trees release monoterpenes into the air.
The study tested which monoterpenes keep insects away.
A genizah is a storage room for old Hebrew books.
Old prayer books go to the genizah, not the trash.
Scholars found thousands of old letters in the genizah.
The synagogue keeps its genizah in the attic.
An isoenzyme does the same job as another enzyme but looks different.
The blood test checks heart isoenzymes after chest pain.
The liver and muscles make different isoenzymes.
High levels of this isoenzyme can show bone disease.

seborrhea.note: British spelling is "seborrhoea"; "seborrheic dermatitis" is more common.

ex: A zooid is one small animal in a colony.
Each zooid in the coral colony has its own job.
Some zooids catch food, and others protect the colony.
Under the microscope, we saw hundreds of tiny zooids.
Cathinone is a stimulant found in the leaves of the khat plant.
Chewing khat leaves releases cathinone into the body.
Cathinone is illegal in many countries.
The lab test found cathinone in the sample.
A centriole is a small tube-shaped part inside animal cells.
Centrioles help the cell divide into two.
Most animal cells have two centrioles near the nucleus.
Plant cells usually do not have a centriole.

longplay.note: Most often "longplay" is a video of a whole video game. A music album is an "LP".

ex: A singspiel is a German comic opera with spoken dialogue.
Many singspiels were popular in Vienna in the 1700s.
The school theater staged a short singspiel for parents.
In a singspiel, actors speak between the songs.

stroboscope.note: "Strobe" or "strobe light" is the common everyday word.

glibenclamide.note: "Glyburide" is the usual name in the US.

ex: A paralog is a copy of a gene inside the same species.
Humans have several paralogs of this growth gene.
The two paralogs now do slightly different jobs.
The software finds paralogs in the genome automatically.

gastarbeiter.note: German word; "guest worker" or "migrant worker" is common in English.

ex: A shapefile stores map data like roads and rivers.
Open the shapefile in the map program to see the borders.
Can you send me the shapefile of the city parks?
The city shares a free shapefile of all bus routes.
A graptolite is a small fossil animal from ancient seas.
We found graptolites in the dark rocks near the river.
Graptolites help geologists find the age of rocks.
The museum has a graptolite that looks like a tiny saw.
A neuroblast is a young cell that becomes a nerve cell.
In the embryo, neuroblasts divide very quickly.
Neuroblasts move to the right place in the growing brain.
The scientists studied neuroblasts in fruit flies.
